editorial:
Imagine meeting someone who sees the world exactly the way you do, even when everything feels like it is falling apart. You will follow Violet and Finch, two high schoolers who are both dealing with some really heavy stuff in their private lives. They start a school project together to find the best spots in Indiana, and as they travel, they start to lean on each other. The vibe is very bittersweet; it feels like a warm hug but also makes you want to cry because you can feel how much they are hurting inside. It is a story about finding light in the dark and how one person can change your whole outlook on life.

The acting is great because the leads feel like real teenagers, not just actors reading lines. While the story moves a bit slow at times, the emotional payoff is huge. If you enjoy movies that make you feel everything, you will love this one.
endingExplained: After a beautiful summer, Finch struggles with his mental health and eventually takes his own life. Violet is heartbroken and lost, but she finds comfort in the list of bright places they visited together. She realizes that Finch loved her and wanted her to keep living. The movie ends with her honoring his memory and finding the strength to move forward, showing that love stays with you even after someone is gone.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves emotional stories about young love and mental health.
